subject: Literature
title: Kate Chopin's The Awakening
description: A 60-second lesson on Kate Chopin's The Awakening.

hook.text: Kate Chopin's The Awakening was so scandalous in 1899 that it destroyed her career and was forgotten for sixty years.

buildup.text: The novel follows Edna Pontellier, a married woman who discovers her own desires and refuses to suppress them any longer.

discovery.text: Chopin dared to portray a woman choosing personal freedom over motherhood and marriage, shocking Victorian readers.

twist.text: The novel was rediscovered in the 1960s by feminist scholars and is now considered a masterpiece of American literature.

climax.text: Chopin's career was destroyed because she told the truth about women's inner lives sixty years too early.

punchline.text: The truth she told in 1899 only became acceptable in 1969.

quiz.question: What happened to Chopin's career after publishing The Awakening?
options: She became America's most celebrated author
The scandal destroyed her career and the book was forgotten for sixty years
She was invited to lecture at universities across America
